When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, certain values increase in its stat block. * * * ## Swarm Spirit Medium swarm of Tiny beasts, unaligned * * * - **Armor Class** 10 + the level of the spell (natural armor) - **Hit Points** 10 + 5 for each spell level above 2nd - **Speed (Spiders)** 30 ft., climb 30 ft. - **Speed (Quippers)** 5 ft., swim 30 ft. - **Speed (Wasps)** 5 ft., fly 30 ft. * * * | STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 3 (-4) | 13 (+1) | 10 (+0) | 1 (-5) | 7 (-2) | 1 (-5) | * * * - **Damage Resistances** bludgeoning, piercing, slashing - **Senses** blindsight 10 ft., passive Perception 8 - **Languages** understands the languages you speak - **Proficiency** equals your bonus * * * _**Spider Climb (Spiders only).**_ The swarm can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check. _ **Swarm** _ The swarm can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm can’t regain hit points or gain temporary hit points. _**Web Walker (Spiders only)**_ The swarm ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing. _**Water Breathing (Sea Only).**_ The animal can breathe underwater. * * *

Actions

Multiattack. The swarm makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (rounded down). Bite (Quippers only). Melee Weapon Attack: your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 3d4 + the spell's level piercing damage. Sting (Spiders and Wasps only). Melee Weapon Attack: your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 2d4 + the spell's level piercing damage + 1d4 poison damage.
